nodes.description: Mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances; the key state variable read and written by every transfer path.
Token name string initialized to 'BITCLOUT'.
Token symbol string initialized to 'BTCT'.
Token decimals, set to 18.
Fixed total supply 21000000 * 10**18 minted to the contract owner in the constructor.
Owner address assigned from msg.sender in the constructor; also used as a privileged recipient in transfer/transferFrom whitelist checks.
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address allowed as a transfer recipient and pre-approved spender.
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 factory address allowed as a transfer recipient.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of owner to spender approvals.
Constructor: sets contractOwner = msg.sender, mints totalSupply to msg.sender and grants the Uniswap router a large allowance.
ERC20 transfer that first checks sender balance and then enforces a restrictive recipient whitelist.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value and emits Approval; no zero-address or return-value safety handling.
ERC20 transferFrom that checks balance and allowance, enforces the recipient whitelist, then moves balances and reduces the allowance.
Caller-controlled address; used as owner key, balance key and allowance owner throughout the contract.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value in transfer: unchecked subtraction in Solidity 0.5.17 (no SafeMath).
balanceOf[to] += value in transfer: unchecked addition with no overflow protection.
balanceOf[from] -= value in transferFrom: unchecked subtraction with no SafeMath.
balanceOf[to] += value in transferFrom: unchecked addition with no SafeMath.
allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value in transferFrom: unchecked subtraction of the allowance.
require(to == contractOwner || balanceOf[to] == 0 || to == uniFactory || to == uniRouter) in transfer: privileged recipient restriction.
Identical privileged recipient restriction require statement inside transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Amount parameter of approve.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender supplies the initial owner value to the constructor.
contractOwner is written directly from msg.sender without any ownership validation or two-step transfer.
Constructor performs the privileged assignment to contractOwner.
msg.sender indexes balanceOf and is the debited account in transfer.
msg.sender is the owner key of the allowance mapping in approve.
msg.sender is the spender key used when consuming the allowance in transferFrom.
transfer executes the unchecked sender balance subtraction.
transfer executes the unchecked recipient balance addition.
transferFrom executes the unchecked source balance subtraction.
transferFrom executes the unchecked recipient balance addition.
transferFrom executes the unchecked allowance subtraction.
transfer is gated by the recipient whitelist require statement.
transferFrom is gated by the recipient whitelist require statement.
transfer reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
approve writes the nested allowance mapping.
transferFrom reads and decrements the nested allowance mapping.
contractOwner is compared against the recipient in the whitelist check of transfer, granting a privileged exemption.
contractOwner is compared against the recipient in the whitelist check of transferFrom, granting a privileged exemption.
uniRouter is whitelisted as an allowed recipient in transfer.
uniFactory is whitelisted as an allowed recipient in transfer.
Recipient parameter indexes balanceOf for the credited amount in transfer.
Recipient parameter is the value tested by the whitelist require in transfer.
Amount parameter is subtracted from the sender balance in transfer.
Spender parameter keys the allowance mapping written by approve.
Amount parameter is the value stored in the allowance mapping by approve.
Source parameter is used in the unchecked balance subtraction of transferFrom.
Recipient parameter indexes balanceOf for the credited amount in transferFrom.
Amount parameter is subtracted from the allowance in transferFrom.

Amount parameter of approve directly feeds the allowance write in approve.
